notes.title: v1.2 Update - Now Live!
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

We just released a major content and navigation improvement update.

Here's what's new:


Distance levels (9 new levels): Put some power into it! Hit targets that are far, far away.
High/low levels (9 new levels): These levels contain only high and low targets which will be a pain in the neck to hit.
Corner kick levels (9 new levels): We added corner kicks by popular demand (also because they're a lot of fun).
Improved menu navigation: Now you won't have to go through player customization every time you select Single Player.
Retry level button: Now you'll be able to replay a level without having to go through the menu again.


This update increases the available number of levels from 18 to 45!

Enjoy the new levels and thanks for playing Hat Trick Header.

notes.title: Upcoming v1.2 update - Lots of New Levels and Improved Menu Navigation
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

Here's what we're working on:

    Sniper mode levels (9 new levels): Put some power into it! Hit targets that are far, far away.
    High/low mode levels (9 new levels): These levels contain only high and low targets which will be a pain in the neck to hit.
    Corner kick mode levels (9 new levels): We're adding corner kicks by popular demand (also because they're a lot of fun).
    Improved menu navigation: Now you won't have to go through player customization every time you select Single Player.
    Replay level button: Now you'll be able to replay a level without having to go through the menu again.

This is a big content update which will increase the number of unique levels from 18 to 45 (more than 2x)! 

We're planning to release the update in the coming few weeks.

Thanks for playing Hat Trick Header!
